_comment: The lookup that decides which tab a new invoice request goes into. When a CP 'Invoice Summary' email names a client company, the code checks THIS file first (exact match, case/spacing-insensitive). Add every client you bill through here — this is the file to maintain, not the Python code. If a company isn't listed here, the code falls back to scanning the existing tabs (USA/UK/Poland 2026) for that exact company name already sitting in a row — if it finds one, it uses that tab AND adds the company here automatically so next time is instant. If neither finds a match, the invoice is flagged 'entity_unresolved' and NOT appended anywhere — it will never silently guess a tab for money.
_scope_note: Foreign clients only for now (USA/UK/Poland) — no tax applied to any of them. India and Kar Ventures are intentionally not wired up. If an Indian client comes in, tell me and I'll add GST support + an India tab back in.

companies.note: seen in your uploaded tracker (Poland entity, bills in USD)

_singapore_note: No 'Singapore' tab exists in your tracker. If a CP email names a Singapore client, it will come back 'entity_unresolved' until you either add a Singapore tab (tell me and I'll wire it up the same way as the other three) or map that client to one of the existing tabs above.
